changed: Nothing animates when you use the keyboard: a shortcut, an arrow key or Tab shows its result at once.
On a phone the page no longer rubber-bands or pulls to refresh, and the small controls are easier to tap.
fixed: On a phone, suggestions and My Gear search results are no longer hidden under the keyboard.
Searching a product that comes in several sizes shows each size instead of the same cut-off name on every row.
Holding an arrow key in a weight field or pressing + quickly no longer blanks the total, and reordering folders no longer makes one blink.
Swiping over the route map on a phone scrolls the page, and dragging gear out of My Gear works after a short hold.
Long names no longer spill out of the account page, people chips or the headline, and a one-item list no longer says 1 items.
